    return out

from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The large corner-shaped marker supplies the replacement color. Find its
    # color as the non-background color with the greatest connected component
    # having a substantial horizontal and vertical arm.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg}
    comps = []
    for color in colors:
        seen = set()
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[r][c] != color or (r,c) in seen: continue
                q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==color:
                            seen.add(p); q.append(p)
                comps.append((color,comp))
    # Locate the prominent L-shaped color marker, then recolor the largest
    # connected object in the direction of its open corner.
    marker_color, marker = max(comps, key=lambda z: len(z[1]))
    mr=[p[0] for p in marker]; mc=[p[1] for p in marker]
    r0,r1=min(mr),max(mr); c0,c1=min(mc),max(mc)
    corners=[]
    for r in (r0,r1):
        for c in (c0,c1):
            # count marker pixels on the corner's row/column arms
            score=sum(1 for y,x in marker if y==r or x==c)
            corners.append((score,r,c))
    _,cr,cc=max(corners)
    # Prefer candidate components lying in the unoccupied quadrant of the L.
    open_up = (cr == r1)  # vertical arm extends upward from corner
    open_left = (cc == c1) # horizontal arm extends left from corner
    candidates=[]
    for color,comp in comps:
        if color==marker_color: continue
        cy=sum(y for y,x in comp)/len(comp); cx=sum(x for y,x in comp)/len(comp)
        if (cy < cr if open_up else cy > cr) and (cx < cc if open_left else cx > cc):
            candidates.append((len(comp),color,comp))
    if not candidates:
        candidates=[(len(comp),color,comp) for color,comp in comps if color!=marker_color]
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,_,target=max(candidates,key=lambda z:z[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c]=marker_color
    return out

                left = any(c < ec and r == er for r, c in cells)
